AdminAccount.version is the decimal-string representation of account_version (bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, CHECK > 0). It is the control aggregate version for global_role/status/deleted_at, distinct from profile_version and auth_version. Under the auth user-row lock compare the expected account version, recheck authority and state, then increment once in the same transaction for each actual role/state/logical-deletion transition, including invitation acceptance, login lock/unlock and bootstrap/recovery when those flows change existing control fields. Account creation starts at version 1. Idempotent replay/no-op does not increment; profile-only updates do not substitute this clock. Schema migration belongs to TAS-477; administrative transition logic and GET mapping belong to TAS-485, deletion transition consumer TAS-487. A retained deletion tombstone exposes no historical profile PII; after lawful physical purge administrative GET returns 404.

new_tables.notes: Append-only matching of one verified receipt to at most one invoice. Not final allocation, not paid coverage. Under ordered source/invoice locks, match min(unmatched available source amount, remaining invoice total); sum matches <= invoice total and each source amount.
